New Developments

List for Free on PropertyList.es

LAUNCH DATE: 25th Augusts 2025

Are you a property developer looking to showcase your new-build projects to a wider audience—at zero cost? PropertyList.es is your opportunity to get direct exposure without any listing fees.

Why List on PropertyList.es?

  • 100% Free to List – No hidden charges, no subscription plans. Simply upload your developments and start generating interest.

  • Paid Fetaures – Highlight Developments – Make your project stand out with enhanced visibility on the homepage and in newsletters and much more coming soon.

  • Access to Active Agents – Your properties become instantly searchable and shareable by hundreds of local and international agents working with direct clients.

  • No Middlemen – Agents can send your properties directly to buyers, boosting visibility and increasing the chances of a quicker sale.

  • Easy to Onboard – We support various data feeds and can help get your listings live fast.

Designed to Help You Sell

Whether you’re launching a new phase or selling the final units, PropertyList.es is a powerful tool to amplify your reach—at no cost. Add your developments today and let agents help bring you qualified buyers.

👉 Start listing now. It’s free, fast, and built to help you sell.

Free Access for Agents

Looking for high-quality new-build properties to offer your clients? With PropertyList.es, you get completely free access to a growing database of new developments from trusted developers across Spain.

Why Use PropertyList.es?

  • Free to Use – No sign-up fees, no subscriptions. Search, save, and share listings without paying a cent.

  • New-Builds from Top Developers – Gain instant access to the latest developments, including off-plan and under-construction properties.

  • Ready-to-Share Listings – Each property is fully detailed and shareable with your direct clients, helping you present opportunities professionally and instantly.

  • Save Time – No need to chase developers or request marketing materials. Everything’s in one place, ready to go.

Built for Agents Who Want to Sell Smarter

Whether you’re working with investors, relocators, or first-time buyers, PropertyList.es gives you the tools to deliver results—quickly, professionally, and for free.

👉 Start exploring new developments today and match your clients with the perfect property.
